The recording is deleted as soon as it is text; the text goes into the answer box and is submitted like typing. For a cloze, say “first blank …, second blank …”. Shift+V says your question into “Help me understand”. Add a transcription service in Settings › Audio transcription first, or install the live class's local transcription.

A miss graded after you moved on waits under “Corrections to read” beside the question number and in “This round” on the result page; “Got it · add a retry” puts it at the end of the round.
